note: April OMR: Hormuz crude and condensate exports dropped by 14.2 mb/d to 1.9 mb/d; all oil 2.3 mb/d.
May OMR: all oil via Hormuz 2.7 mb/d, times March's crude share of 0.83.
June OMR implies all oil via Hormuz of 2.7 mb/d in May (June 8.2 after a 5.5 rise), times the 0.83 crude share.
July OMR: all oil via Hormuz 8.2 mb/d, times June's crude share of Gulf exports (13.2 of 16.1 mb/d).
IEA: Hormuz flows averaged 7.6 mb/d in August (search excerpt), times the 0.82 crude share. Update when the OMR is supplied.
